description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is the publisher's "Check for updates" badge: a square graphic with a light-grey rounded frame containing a circular arrow formed from a blue arc and a yellow arc, enclosing a solid dark-red bookmark/ribbon shape. Below the icon, two lines of dark sans-serif text read "Check for" and "updates". There are no axes, no units, no gridlines, no data points, no error bars, no scale bar, no magnification, no legend, no micrograph, no spectrum and no sample or processing-condition labels of any kind. The graphic carries no scientific measurement and cannot support any claim about the Fe-30Mn-9Al-0.8 C low-density steel, its multiaxial forging passes, its XRD or EBSD characterisation, or its Johnson-Cook plastic-flow modelling. It most likely appears in this group because a router or layout parser mistook this reference-manager stamp for a numbered figure panel; the actual figure it was attached to is not present in the supplied pixels. Downstream agents should treat this group as containing no extractable materials-science content, and the declared image_type is therefore nominal only.
